about: Jim Chalat is an attorney providing legal services covering Personal Injury - General: Plaintiff, Personal Injury - Medical Malpractice: Plaintiff, Personal Injury - Products: Plaintiff and Professional Liability: Plaintiff.

Jim Chalat, who practices law in Denver, Colorado, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2006 - 2027. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at University of Denver Sturm College of Law. He graduated in 1977. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 1977.
